camera.shot_scale_bias: extreme close-ups of eyes cut against extreme wide landscapes
camera.height: low, looking up at the standing figure

lens.focal_bias: a wide anamorphic lens for the landscapes and a long lens for the faces
lens.dof: deep in the wides, shallow on the close-ups

lighting.practicals: midday sun with no fill, so eyes sit in deep shadow

palette.grade: warm and dusty with blown highlights

rules: a face fills the entire frame with the eyes on the centre line
a single figure stands tiny against an empty horizon
composition.movement_of_subject: almost nothing moves; tension is carried by stillness and the wait

sound.ambience_bias: wind across open ground, creaking wood, buzzing flies, a distant bell

music.instrumentation: A twanging electric guitar over sparse percussion, with a whistled line
music.dynamics: holding back for a long stretch before a sudden full-orchestra entry

must_include: the shot alternates between an extreme close-up of a face and an extreme wide of empty land
dust hangs in the hot air

notes: The scale gap is the style: eyes filling the frame against a horizon that swallows the figure. Long waits, hard sun, sudden action.
